profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead at Meta | Serverless Computing, Distributed Systems, AI Functions
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead at Meta on Serverless Computing. I lead the teams behind Meta's internal FaaS platform and Async, the distributed compute platform it runs on. I built the initial FaaS platform for a single pilot customer and took it to General Availability. It now powers tens of thousands of use cases, from AI training to ads.

Most recently I built AI Functions on top of FaaS, a code-first platform for agent automation. It reached 700+ daily active use cases in its first few months.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Serverless Computing
positions.description:
Tech Lead for the team building Meta's greenfield FaaS (Function as a Service) internal cloud offering, powering 10s of thousands of usecases. Took the platform from prototype to General Availability, building a flywheel with customers to understand their requirements to evolve the platform to clear Product Market Fit. To make this possible, I worked with our team to design the quota model, deployment,  authoring, UX, and much more. FaaS now powers tens of thousands of company use cases, from AI training to ads.

Partnered with the training workflows team to migrate Ads pre-training workflows to FaaS. Cut training TTFB start times by 7 minutes, an estimated $200MM+ in developer time savings in the training hotpath.

Created AI Functions on top of FaaS, a code-first platform for building agent automation, with the DevInfra org. AI Functions makes it simple for teams to automate agentic actions at Meta. AI Functions now powers 700+ daily active use cases, including AI code review, AI alarm/SEV remediation, AI Training evals, and Ads A/B testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Serverless Computing
positions.description:
Led privacy and security for the Serverless org. Built the DataSchemaDefinition framework, a simpler abstraction that made it easier for our platforms and 100s of others at Meta to become privacy aware. It became the key charter for a privacy team.

Led the Serverless Functions asynchronous execution platform, which powers trillions of executions per day. Owned reliability for the team and onboarded and mentored new engineers.

Intern Director (2019 to 2023): worked with three intern cohorts and their managers on project plans and calibrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Monetization Integrity
positions.description: Turned a pull-based system with 36 hours of delay into a push-based system with seconds of delay, which greatly reduced time to remove bad actors. Built an HDFS to Serverless adapter to process integrity signals, then joined Serverless to build the platform.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on the Payment Processing Infrastructure team as a software engineering intern.  This involved working with Python, C++, PHP/Hack, and MySQL in order to create essential new components of their framework.  Additionally, I coordinated an important effort with the finance and operation teams, driving implementation.

positions.title: Computer Science Peer Mentor
positions.description: I ran four 1-hour tutorial sessions helping students in the introductory computer science class better understand the material.  I additionally held office hours, where I tutor students one-on-one.  Additionally, in the spring quarters I worked as a peer mentor for EECS 214: Data Structures and Data Management, where I held additional recitations as well as office hours.  In the Winter Quarter, I worked on EECS 211: Fundamentals of Computer Programming II.  In this class, I created worksheets and labs to enrich students' learning of important concepts to computer science.

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description: Co-founded NoteShark, a startup that offered education enrichment through carefully selected study guides for sale on our website. Worked as the sole developer, developing NoteShark using technologies including Python, Django, Heroku, AWS, and Stripe.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on speeding up dated, integral parts of the Credit team's system, using techniques such as parallelization and vectorization.  In addition, restructured code using modern techniques.

positions.title: Classroom Intern
positions.description: I worked in the classroom teaching and mentoring 1st graders on reading, writing, math, and social skills as a volunteer for 3 years, before becoming a Classroom intern in the 2014 and 2015 summers.

projects.title: Jamii
projects.description: Created an Android Application in Java in order to help Child refugees get reconnected with their families and communities in Africa.  Although Jamii never ended up getting implemented in Africa, I did work with United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees in order to make progress on those ends.
